## Three Product Directions

### 1. Training-Time Diagnostic API (B2B SaaS)

- **Wedge:** `sart.diagnose(model, train_data, val_data)` → per-sample shortcut report
- **Entry:** Free diagnostic tier → paid correction (reweighting + surgery)
- **Expand:** CI/CD integration, per-model monitoring, compliance dashboards
- **Comp:** Weights & Biases pricing model ($0 → $50/seat → enterprise)

### 2. Robustness-Certified Fine-Tuning (Platform Play)

- **Wedge:** Partner with fine-tuning providers (Together AI, Anyscale, Fireworks)
- **Value:** "Your fine-tuned model, guaranteed X% robustness on shifted inputs"
- **Moat:** Proprietary benchmark suite + gradient diagnostics in the tuning loop

### 3. Compliance & Audit Tooling (Regulated Industries)

- **Wedge:** Quantitative robustness metrics → audit-ready reports
- **Entry:** Financial institutions, healthcare AI companies
- **Driver:** EU AI Act, FDA AI/ML guidance require demonstrable robustness

::: {.callout-note}
**Speculative.** These directions are informed by market observation but have not been validated with customer discovery. The technology is at the research stage with reproducible experimental results.
:::

---

## Market Pain Points

| Pain Point | Current Workaround | Why It Fails |
|-----------|-------------------|-------------|
| Models fail on edge cases post-deployment | Manual red-teaming | Expensive, incomplete, doesn't scale |
| No robustness metrics for auditors | Ad hoc evaluation suites | Not standardized, not training-integrated |
| Fine-tuning degrades model quality | Conservative hyperparameters | Sacrifices adaptation quality |
| Domain data contains unknown shortcuts | Data cleaning / filtering | Requires knowing shortcuts in advance |
